{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue to detect QA orders
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Exclude QA orders from the converted group
# First, get all converted customers with valid age
converted = sales[(sales['converted'] == 1) & (sales['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Now, remove QA orders from this group
converted_clean = converted[~converted['order_id'].isin(qa_orders['order_id'])]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_clean['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (after removing QA orders and missing age): {mean_age:.2f}")

# Output for evidence
print(f"Number of converted customers after cleaning: {len(converted_clean)}")"}
